breadcrumb: Std 6 Science (English) — Unit 7: Computer - An Introduction — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Initially the people used a tool called abacus for calculations. Later they started using a device called calculator.

en.q: Which tool was used for calculations before the invention of the computer?
en.explanation: Before computers, people calculated with the abacus, a frame of sliding beads.

ta.q: கணினி கண்டுபிடிக்கும் முன் கணக்கிட மக்கள் பயன்படுத்திய கருவி ______.
ta.explanation: கணினிக்கு முன் மக்கள் மணிகள் நகரும் சட்டமான அபாகஸைக் கொண்டு கணக்கிட்டனர். (மேலும்: அபாகஸ்.)

questions.quote: In the First generation computers, Vacuum tube was used. Second - Transistor. Third - Integrated Circuits. Fourth - Micro processor. Fifth - Artificial Intelligence.

en.explanation: First generation used vacuum tubes; third used integrated circuits; fourth used microprocessors.

ta.explanation: முதல் தலைமுறை வெற்றிடக் குழாய், மூன்றாம் தலைமுறை ஒருங்கிணைந்த சுற்று.

questions.quote: Generations of Computer: 1940-1956 Vacuum tubes; 1956-1963 Transistor; 1964-1971 Integrated Circuit; 1971 onwards Micro Processor.

en.q: Which period belongs to the first generation of computers (vacuum tubes)?

ta.q: முதல் தலைமுறைக் கணினிகளின் (வெற்றிடக் குழாய்) காலம் எது?

questions.quote: The software used to operate the computer is called operating software. I think you are familiar with Windows and Linux.

en.q: Which of the following is an operating software?
en.explanation: Windows and Linux are operating software.

questions.quote: Application software is a software that is used to run a particular program. For example, the software used for painting, playing games in computer.

en.q: A painting software is an example of ______ software.
en.explanation: Application software runs a particular program.

ta.explanation: பயன்பாட்டு மென்பொருள் குறிப்பிட்ட நிரலை இயக்கப் பயன்படும்.

questions.quote: The data or information that has been sent to the computer are displayed out through some devices called output devices. For example, printer, monitor.

en.q: Which of the following is an output device?
en.explanation: Printer and monitor are output devices.

questions.quote: Hey Salim ... The big computers are shrunk into small smart phones nowadays because of the technological development.

en.q: Big computers have shrunk into small devices like ______ because of technological development.
en.explanation: The works done with a computer can also be done using a smart phone.

ta.q: தொழில்நுட்ப வளர்ச்சியால் பெரிய கணினிகள் ______ போன்ற சிறிய சாதனங்களாகச் சுருங்கியுள்ளன.

questions.quote: The computers that we use today belongs to fifth generation.

en.q: The computers we use today belong to the ______ generation.
en.explanation: Artificial Intelligence is used in the fifth generation.

ta.q: இன்று நாம் பயன்படுத்தும் கணினிகள் ______ தலைமுறையைச் சேர்ந்தவை.
